card.name: The start of words beginning with pro
card.fires_on: The piece "pro" (any case) when it begins a longer word that is split up, such as pro-bed, pro-ceed, PRO-TECTED, pro-longed, pro-pranolol, pro-thrombin. It fires on the opening piece, before the rest of the word.

modes.label: Lowercase pro opening a word
modes.description: A lowercase "pro" that starts a word split into pieces, in prose or drug names.
modes.example: The usual dosage is 60 mg<< pro>>pranolol hydrochloride daily in

modes.label: Capitalised PRO or Pro
modes.description: An all-caps or capitalised "PRO" starting a word in warning text or a sentence.
modes.example: ADMINISTRATION OF AMPHETAMINES FOR<< PRO>>LONGED PERIODS OF TIME MAY

card.writes: It pushes toward words like dream and projection, and away from more "pro" pieces, so it does not point to the true continuation.
card.plain: It marks the start of a word that begins with "pro" and is split into pieces, such as propranolol or prolonged.
